summary: A field scarecrow: a weathered timber post and crossbar on a mound of earth, a straw-stuffed check shirt rope… joints legs_swing, head_sway; options shirt_colour, trouser_colour, head, hat, crow; sockets perch_l, perch_r, sign_front.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.scarecrow or place "prefab": "scarecrow" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
